$comment: Resource registry for jumbo_worker.pool. HBM figures are estimates from docs/architecture.md §4.2 until the S0 spikes profile them; hbm_ceiling is set by spike 6 (0.80 or 0.90).

magi_v2.notes: Magi v2 (ragavsachdeva/magiv2, personal/non-commercial weights): panels, texts + OCR, speakers, characters per image. Tall slices are tiled. First wake downloads ~2 GB from the HF Hub. Spike 2 profiles HBM and speed.

drama3.notes: Fish Audio Drama 3 (35B MoE, 3B active) through speech.cpp 0.8.11 built for CUDA sm_75 with the dual-GPU and memory-cap patch; weights sakasegawa/drama-3-GGUF. Spike 4 on a T4 (Q6_K, uncapped): 14 of 40 layers' experts on the card, the rest on 4 CPU threads; peak 14.7 GB GPU, 20.8 GB RAM, load 120 s, 1.6 s per second of audio. 44.1 kHz. Quant and replica layout are set by spike 5. On a TPU host it does not run yet (no ggml TPU backend; TorchTPU is the path to test).

qwen25vl_72b_int8.notes: TP=8 Director. vLLM fills each chip to gpu_memory_utilization (= hbm_ceiling). Unvalidated on vLLM TPU; spike 6.

librarian.notes: Memory-R2 7B or the Qwen2.5-7B fallback, guided MemoryDelta output. Spike 4.

remotion.notes: One chapter render per replica. Throughput from spike 5.
